interfaces.name: Web client
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed by manipulating presented affordances (channels, messages, menus, forms) over a persistent, navigable representation of workspace state.

provenance.evidence: Official downloads pages present the web app alongside native clients as a first-party surface.

interfaces.name: Desktop app
interfaces.classification_rationale: A separate first-party client surface whose primitive is affordance manipulation over a navigable representation of service state.

provenance.evidence: Official installer for Windows with system-tray integration and global shortcuts.

interfaces.name: Mobile app
interfaces.classification_rationale: Independent first-party client surface; actions are expressed through affordance manipulation with real-time sync.

provenance.evidence: Official Android app distributed via Google Play.
Official iOS app distributed via the App Store.

interfaces.name: Web API
interfaces.technology: HTTP RPC methods at slack.com/api/METHOD.method, bearer token
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations through structured HTTP RPC requests (Operation Invocation).

provenance.evidence: Collection of 200+ HTTP RPC-style methods over HTTPS with bearer-token auth; absorbs Conversations, Calls, Presence, Slack Connect, Legal Holds, admin methods and the Real-Time Search API sharing the same base and auth.

interfaces.name: Incoming Webhooks
interfaces.technology: POST to a secret URL at hooks.slack.com/services/...
interfaces.classification_rationale: Consumer-to-Slack direction: the consumer invokes a post-message operation against a unique webhook URL; distinct base and auth model from the Web API.

provenance.evidence: Official SDK describes @slack/webhook for sending notifications to a channel via incoming webhooks.

interfaces.name: SCIM API
interfaces.classification_rationale: Explicit invocation of provider-defined provisioning operations following the SCIM standard; separate base and auth but the same operation-invocation paradigm.

provenance.evidence: SCIM API listed for user provisioning and management.

interfaces.name: Audit Logs API
interfaces.technology: Audit REST endpoints, organization admin token
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes audit operations (the /logs endpoint) over a distinct base and auth; Operation Invocation.

provenance.evidence: Official Audit Logs client documents the /logs endpoint for SIEM tools requiring an org admin token.

interfaces.name: Status API
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer queries provider-defined operations to monitor product health; Operation Invocation.

provenance.evidence: Official APIs index describes the Status API as a programmatic way to monitor the health of the Slack product.

interfaces.name: Slack CLI
interfaces.technology: Command-line interface for creating and managing apps
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed as explicit commands authorized against the workspace; the command reference shows no persistent navigable TUI dashboard, so no second Interactive interface arises.

provenance.evidence: CLI to create and manage Slack apps from the command line, with an authorization flow and a command reference.

interfaces.name: Events API and interactivity
interfaces.technology: HTTP delivery to a Request URL, or Socket Mode WebSocket
interfaces.classification_rationale: The service initiates delivery when a subscribed event or user interaction occurs and pushes the payload to a consumer-controlled receiver (Event Notification); Socket Mode is a transport for the same contract.

provenance.evidence: Events API documented with HTTP Request URLs and Socket Mode; interactivity (slash commands, shortcuts, block actions) delivers payloads to a configured Request URL.

interfaces.name: Legacy RTM API
interfaces.classification_rationale: The service streams real-time events to the consumer's persistent WebSocket receiver. Deprecated/legacy, retained for inventory completeness; adds no new channel.

provenance.evidence: Described as an outmoded WebSocket API providing access to some functionality of the Web and Events APIs.

interfaces.name: Slack MCP server
interfaces.technology: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP at mcp.slack.com/mcp
interfaces.classification_rationale: Exposes semantically described tools (search, read/send messages, canvases, lists, files, users) that MCP clients discover and select as part of the interaction contract (Capability Discovery and Invocation).

provenance.evidence: Official MCP server at mcp.slack.com/mcp exposing a documented tool set over JSON-RPC 2.0, with OAuth and admin-approved client apps.

interfaces.name: Slackbot AI assistant
interfaces.technology: Natural-language conversational assistant with internal tool orchestration
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer interacts through natural-language messages interpreted by the service; tool orchestration via Slackbot's MCP client is internal, not a consumer-facing discovery contract, so it is Conversational rather than Agentic.

provenance.evidence: Slackbot presented as a single conversational interface: the user asks in plain language and Slackbot locates the right tool and coordinates the steps.
